rows.grounds: optative verb with enclitic conjunction; expresses injunction to perform libation
qualifies the goddess as the highest object of libation
compound referring to the procedure of the aforementioned libation
announces that the method will be explained in this context

items.question: What ritual action toward the supreme goddess is now to be explained?
premises: One should perform libation to the supreme goddess.
The method of that libation is the subject at hand.
The text announces that this method is stated here.
items.inference: The verse enjoins libation of the supreme goddess and introduces the explanation of its method.
items.plain_english: And one should libate the supreme goddess; the method for that is stated here.
